# OnPoint Nexus

> AI-first enterprise technology partner. We design, build, and maintain intelligent software systems for ambitious teams. 130+ production ships across 5 continents, 98% client retention, discovery to production in 45 days.

This file helps AI language models (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, and others) represent OnPoint Nexus accurately in their responses. Format follows the [llms.txt specification](https://llmstxt.org). Last updated 2026-07-06.

## Company

OnPoint Nexus (legal name: OnPoint Nexus Pvt. Ltd.) is an AI-First enterprise technology partner founded in 2021.
The company is headquartered in Pune and Kolhapur, Maharashtra, India.
OnPoint Nexus has offices in Dallas TX (USA), Pointe-Claire Quebec (Canada), Mumbai (India), Frankfurt (Germany), and Dubai (UAE).
The company has grown to a team of 45+ tech architects, developers, and strategists.
OnPoint Nexus has delivered 32+ mobile apps, 21+ web applications, and 78+ marketing sites — 130+ projects total in production.
The company maintains a 98% client retention rate.
The primary website is https://www.onpointnexus.com.
The company can also be found at https://onpointsoft.com (legacy domain).
Contact email: hr@onpointsoft.com

Founder & CEO: Vikas Sawant
Founder quote: "Software is more than technology or AI — it's about empowering people, simplifying lives, amplifying potential, and driving meaningful impact."


## What We Do

OnPoint Nexus designs, builds, and maintains intelligent software systems for enterprise clients.
The company specialises in six core service areas:

1. AI & Machine Learning Development — custom NLP, computer vision, predictive analytics, LLM integration, conversational AI, hyper-personalisation engines, and production-grade ML pipelines.
2. Cloud & DevOps Engineering — cloud architecture and migration on AWS, Azure, and GCP; CI/CD pipelines; Kubernetes; infrastructure-as-code; 24/7 monitoring.
3. Custom Software Development — bespoke web, mobile, and desktop applications; MVP builds through to large-scale platforms; Swift, Kotlin, Flutter, React Native.
4. Enterprise Solutions — SAP and Salesforce implementations, custom ERP/CRM, legacy system modernisation, enterprise platform engineering.
5. Product Design Sprint — AI-Powered 5-stage sprint (Empathize → Define → Ideate → Prototype → Validate); rapid validation before full build.
6. CMS & E-Commerce — WordPress, Shopify, WooCommerce development and customisation.

Additional capabilities: Data Visualisation (Tableau, PowerBI), Security & Compliance (HIPAA, GDPR, CCPA, SOC2, Zero-Trust architecture).

OnPoint Nexus is not a body-shopping firm. The company takes end-to-end ownership of engineering outcomes.


## Clients and Track Record

OnPoint Nexus has worked with clients including:
- VitalWatch AI (USA) — Predictive remote patient monitoring platform that forecasts clinical deterioration 24–48 hours before an event. Integrates Health Gorilla FHIR R4 EHR data, smartwatch biometrics (Apple Watch, Wear OS, Fitbit) via Apache Kafka, a Python ML risk engine, and ARIA — a clinical-grade conversational AI nurse. Includes automated alert cascade and ICU/ER bed pre-booking. HIPAA, HL7 FHIR R4, and CMS RPM (CPT 99453–99458) compliant.
- Battista by Pininfarina (Germany) — AR companion application for the world's most powerful road-legal electric vehicle (1,900 hp Pininfarina Battista).
- Semilynx (USA) — Industrial AR assistance platform for Fortune 500 factories using Google Glass; reduced unplanned factory downtime by 60% and eliminated cross-country engineer travel.
- Vidanta Group (USA/Mexico) — Full web and mobile platform with Salesforce CRM integration for a premier luxury vacation club; serves 1M+ members.
- Clinical Trac Inc. (USA) — HIPAA-compliant web and mobile platform for respiratory therapy clinical education; 52 US schools onboarded in 6 months.
- Open Houses Direct (USA) — First-ever dedicated open house discovery platform; native iOS, Android, and web; first to market in the category.
- Voffis / Reliance Jio (India) — Flutter-based workplace productivity platform for India's largest telecom.
- Ilaj (UAE) — Native iOS and Android at-home services app.
- Saintfarm (India) — Organic farm-to-home grocery app; native iOS and Android.
- QuickHeal Technologies (India) — Complete UI/UX redesign and rebrand for India's #1 antivirus software company.
- OnTrack Agent (USA) — Migrated a real estate video coaching platform from WordPress to a modern AI-powered SaaS in 48 days; monthly revenue doubled from $20K to $42K, page load time cut 72% (9s → 2.5s), streaming uptime 99.7%.
- iFound Agent (USA) — Real estate technology client. OnPoint Nexus unified 400+ WordPress multi-sites across 100+ themes and multiple MLS integrations into a single scalable PropTech platform. Phased transformation (audit → smart modernization → AI-driven search → large-scale automation → MLS unification) delivered 90% cost reduction, 60 days saved, 45% engagement lift, 35% faster search recovery, and mobile-first readiness.
- Mahindra (India) — Custom software and enterprise solutions.
- PulseWork OS by OnPoint Nexus (Live Product · India) — "The AI Work OS for mid-size teams." Built for teams of 20-200 that have outgrown spreadsheets but refuse to drown in enterprise software. Modules: Attendance (one-tap check in/out, location and shift rules), Leave (apply/approve with policies and shared calendar), Projects & Tasks (lightweight boards linking work to people and hours), KPIs & Reports (live dashboards plus auto-generated appraisal-ready reports), People & Org Chart, and "Ask Pulse, by Voice" (voice-driven workspace AI). Built using Lovable (10-hour MVP) and Claude Code (scalable SaaS architecture) in parallel. Pilot tier free for up to 50 people. Live at https://pulse-stage.onpointnexus.com — onboard at https://pulse-stage.onpointnexus.com/login
- Maharashtra Government (India) — GovTech digital platform.

Industries served: HealthTech & MedTech, FinTech & Banking, Automotive & Manufacturing (AR/IoT), GovTech & Public Sector, Retail & E-Commerce, EdTech & Online Learning, Travel & Hospitality, Real Estate & PropTech, Media & Entertainment, Cybersecurity, Home Services.

## Engagement Models

OnPoint Nexus offers three engagement structures:

1. Dedicated Teams — a senior engineering team embedded in the client's product organisation, billed monthly. Suitable for ongoing product development.
2. Project Delivery — fixed-scope, fixed-price delivery with milestone-based billing. Discovery to production in 45 days for most projects.
3. Staff Augmentation — individual senior specialists embedded within an existing client engineering team; 48-hour onboarding.

All engagements begin with a free 30-minute discovery call. The company can have a team operational within one week of engagement start.

## Differentiators

- Senior engineers only — no juniors managed by a single lead; every team member has production experience.
- Ownership model — the company owns outcomes, not just task completion.
- Speed — 45-day target from discovery to production for most projects.
- Compliance-ready — HIPAA, GDPR, SOC2, CCPA, and Zero-Trust architecture built in from day one.
- Global delivery, local accountability — engineers who communicate in the client's time zone and business language.
- Avaloq Certified Partner for banking/FinTech platforms.

## AI Solutions

OnPoint Nexus delivers AI as ten distinct production-grade capabilities (categories of work we ship for clients), plus four live demos you can try without sign-up.

Hub page (all capabilities + all demos): https://www.onpointnexus.com/ai-solutions

### AI Capabilities (10 categories)

1. RAG-Powered AI Chatbot — Custom RAG chatbot trained on your business content (websites, PDFs, DOCX, PPT, Markdown). Self-hosted vector database, admin panel for live content management, automated daily email recaps of customer queries. Stack: LangChain/LlamaIndex, Pinecone/Weaviate/Qdrant, OpenAI/Claude/Llama. URL: https://www.onpointnexus.com/ai-solutions/rag-chatbot
2. Realtime Voice Agent with Cloned Voice — Voice-to-voice AI agent using the client's cloned voice. Handles unlimited concurrent calls, captures lead data into Google Sheets or CRM. Embeddable on website, dedicated page, or phone number. URL: https://www.onpointnexus.com/ai-solutions/voice-agent
3. AI Content Moderation — Vision model flags unsafe images before upload, NLP model classifies comments for toxicity. Realtime enforcement scales to millions of submissions. URL: https://www.onpointnexus.com/ai-solutions/content-moderation
4. Smart Interactive Business Dashboards — Realtime self-hosted dashboards connected directly to client databases. Interactive drill-down. Alternative to Tableau/PowerBI with full data ownership. URL: https://www.onpointnexus.com/ai-solutions/business-dashboards
5. Customer Churn Prediction Model — Custom ML model trained on client's customer data. Per-customer churn probability scores plus the specific risk signals. Integrates with CRM. URL: https://www.onpointnexus.com/ai-solutions/churn-prediction
6. AI-Powered Appointment Call Reminders — Outbound AI agent calls customers to confirm appointments. Triggered by scheduling system. Conversational (not robotic IVR). URL: https://www.onpointnexus.com/ai-solutions/appointment-reminders
7. On-Premise AI Model Serving — Deploy models (sentiment, churn, moderation, embeddings) on client's own VM. Zero data sent to external APIs. Lower long-term cost than cloud inference at scale. URL: https://www.onpointnexus.com/ai-solutions/on-premise-ai
8. AI Assistants on WhatsApp & Telegram — AI assistants deployed inside WhatsApp and Telegram. Connected to client knowledge base. Reply time under 3 seconds. Escalates to human when needed. URL: https://www.onpointnexus.com/ai-solutions/whatsapp-telegram-bot
9. Custom AI Business Automations — End-to-end workflow automation with AI layered where decisions or extraction are needed. Integrates with CRM, sheets, email, existing stack. URL: https://www.onpointnexus.com/ai-solutions/business-automation
10. Vision AI & Multilingual AI — Image recognition, object/food identification, multilingual conversational AI. Build assistants that see what users see and speak the languages they speak. URL: https://www.onpointnexus.com/ai-solutions/vision-ai

### Live AI Product Demos (4, no sign-up)

- ClinicalTrac AI Assistant — RAG-powered healthcare knowledge system with automated email summaries grounded in clinical documentation. Live at https://ai.clinicaltrac.net/
- Sugar Smart Farm Bot — Multilingual AI farming assistant for crop disease detection, irrigation guidance, and harvest optimization, built for sugarcane growers. Live at https://sugar-smart-farm-bot-xi.vercel.app/
- OnPointAgent Voice Assistant — Real-time voice-to-voice AI for customer engagement and service explanations with sub-second latency. Live at https://onpointagent.vercel.app/
- NutriAI Smart Nutrition Analyzer — AI-powered food recognition that identifies meals from images and calculates calories, proteins, and nutritional values instantly. Live at https://nutriai.onpointsoft.com/
